(1) /payment renders .wave-empty: tile y=436 56x56 r=18px bg rgba(43,87,216,.08) with a rgb(43,87,216) glyph, 'No payments yet' 17px/600 rgb(16,24,40), 'Payments you record against invoices are listed here.' 14px/400 rgb(91,103,121), the group centred with 44px of air above and 44px below inside a 348px placeholder. (3) the toolbar is one family at one height: /payment is three 40px/999px transparent pills with a rgb(43,87,216) border, /invoice is a 280x40 r=8px white field, a 280x40 r=8px white select, 112x40 and 95x40 outlined pills and a 174x40 solid accent pill, /customer and /quote the same vocabulary, no grey-filled select and no naked circle anywhere. Try a different word.' and adds a 'Clear “zzqqxx9999”' pill that restores the 10 rows, at 1440x900 and at 390x844 alike. SCOPE. BHD IS BYTE-IDENTICAL, so the design judgement decides. Isolated in one session, data held constant, the key forced at document start by a non-configurable window.__ERP_PRODUCT getter plus a setAttribute intercept plus a MutationObserver re-stamp, accent verified #009bc1 on every bhd-erp capture and #2b57d8 on every pnp one. Noise floor first: two identical ON captures differ by 0 px on /payment, /invoice, /customer, /purchase-order, /inventory, mobile /payment and mobile dashboard, and by 145 of 5,184,000 on the dashboard inside css(1294,101)-(1299,109). Then ON vs OFF, OFF being every rule from a sheet whose data-vite-dev-id matches /style/wave/ plus every surviving rule carrying the pnp scope, 360 rules killed each run: with bhd-erp forced the diff is 0/5,184,000 on /payment, /invoice, /customer, /purchase-order and /inventory, 0/1,316,640 on mobile /payment and mobile dashboard, and on the dashboard 145/5,184,000 over the IDENTICAL bbox as its own control, so it is the clock, not a leak. The kill is proven to bite: with pnp forced the same kill moves 2,620,405/5,184,000 px on /payment, 2,414,479 on /invoice, 2,462,085 on /purchase-order, 2,180,795 on /inventory, 4,066,791 on the dashboard and 343,325/1,316,640 on mobile /payment. A11y holds: 17.75:1 for the headline, 5.74:1 for the sentence, 6.07:1 for the accent, all on white, and the system's own action takes a 2px solid rgb(43,87,216) ring at 3px offset reached on the 12th Tab. WHICH PAGES GET WHAT, PLAINLY. FULL designed state with a written sentence: payment, credit-note, debit-note, vendor-bill, suppliers, rfq, journal-entry, projects, approvals, credit/queue, attendance, bank-transfers, plus invoice/quote/customer once filtered, and 7 of those carry a 40px/999px solid accent action. HALF, tile and headline only: purchase-order, delivery-note. ADOPTED BY CSS but still hand-rolled in JSX: inventory. CONCERNS, not counted against this piece. /inventory's 'Add Item' is reached by Tab on the 23rd press with outline=0px and box-shadow none, a WCAG 2.4.7 miss, but the BHD-forced capture shows the identical 0px outline, so it is inherited and un-made rather than introduced.
